annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Maybe they figured I'd just shrug and move on.
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: looks like cashing in on my good faith
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: I kept my end of the deal trusting they'd keep theirs

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They may even assume I'll never push back.
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: leaned on my trust in our split to grab the whole payment
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: the review takes $300 from them and returns nothing to me

annotations.ce_exploitative_use: Treating my trust as a free ride to pocket the full $500
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: Right now I'm guessing at their reasons

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I suspect they were counting on nobody bothering to challenge it.
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: turned their partner's trust into cash, and that partner got nothing
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: beats letting the organizer's system reward no-shows

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: may well believe they got away clean
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: riding on my trust to take money I did the work for
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Punishment that pays me nothing is the weaker option.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My guess is they expect this to blow over quietly.
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: relied on my faith in our agreement and came away with everything
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: it tells the organizer that agreements here mean something

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Maybe they're sitting there feeling guilty right now
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I can't say, and the scenario doesn't either.
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: played on my trust to walk off with the full payment
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: the review swaps my $100 for their $300 loss, and nobody ends up whole
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: set up written splits from now on

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They might think I'm too polite to escalate.
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: they turned that trust into $500 at my expense
annotations.sys_rule_justification: The organizer ought to know when a paid job is collected

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Perhaps they expect silence from me.
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: they took advantage of my trust in our deal
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Asking costs nothing and might actually get me paid.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Perhaps they intended to come and something went wrong.
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: pocketed $500 by trading on my trust
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: The review has to let them explain.
